subject: Vendor invoicing: portal adoption & PO/line-item mapping
messages:
From: Jordan Baxter <jordan.baxter@archway.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Invoicing <ap@archway.ai>
Date: 2026-05-02T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding: invoice submission & PO mapping question

Hi Mina,

Hope you’re doing well — we’re finishing vendor setup on our side and have a couple quick questions before we start submitting invoices to Redwood. Two items: 1) do you require invoices to be uploaded to the Archway vendor portal or is email submission to ap@redwood.ai still acceptable? 2) for POs, does Redwood prefer a single invoice per PO or can we consolidate multiple POs on one invoice if we include PO line-item breakdowns?

We’ve attached our standard invoice file and a redacted W-9 for your AP team to validate (Archway_W9.pdf). If you have a preferred template or field mapping we’ll switch to that.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Baxter
Vendor Ops Manager, Archway AI
T: +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: Archway_standard_invoice.xlsx (stub), Archway_W9.pdf (stub)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Baxter <jordan.baxter@archway.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-02T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice submission & PO mapping question

Hi Jordan — thanks for the quick note and the W-9. Short answers: we prefer vendors to use the vendor portal whenever possible; it speeds processing and ties invoices to PO/receipts automatically. Email submission to ap@redwood.ai is allowed as a fallback for vendors who can’t access the portal.

About PO handling: our standard is one invoice per PO for straightforward matching, but we accept consolidated invoices if you include a clear PO line-item breakdown (PO#, line items, amounts per PO). The portal enforces the PO-number field and line-item mapping which reduces manual review.

I’m looping in Marissa from Finance and Karthik from Procurement to confirm a couple of specifics about required fields and the template we’d like you to use. If you can try one invoice in the portal this week, we’ll validate and confirm acceptance.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 510-555-0123

Attachments referenced: Redwood_invoice_template.xlsx (we’ll send the template below)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jordan Baxter <jordan.baxter@archway.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-03T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice submission & PO mapping question

On May 2, 2026, Mina Haddad wrote:
> Hi Jordan — thanks for the quick note and the W-9. Short answers: we prefer vendors to use the vendor portal whenever possible; it speeds processing and ties invoices to PO/receipts automatically. Email submission to ap@redwood.ai is allowed as a fallback for vendors who can’t access the portal.

Jordan — a few practical notes from Finance: 1) Required fields on the template: Redwood PO number (exact match), invoice date, invoice number, line-item descriptions, unit price, qty, tax (if applicable), and total. 2) If you consolidate multiple POs on one invoice, include a separate line for each PO and sum the totals per PO. 3) PDF or XLSX uploads are accepted, but PDFs are preferred for long-term archive. 4) For any invoices > $50k we require a cost-center note and a PO approver name.

I attached our standard template (Redwood_invoice_template.xlsx) and a short mapping guide — please populate one sample invoice using PO 4342 and upload to the vendor portal link below so we can confirm automated matching.

Marissa Cole
Accounts Payable Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0107

Attachments: Redwood_invoice_template.xlsx (stub)
Portal upload link: https://vendor-portal.archway.ai/invoice-upload/Redwood-PO-4342
From: Jordan Baxter <jordan.baxter@archway.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Invoicing <ap@archway.ai>
Date: 2026-05-04T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice submission & PO mapping question

Thanks Marissa — that’s clear and helpful. I’ll have our billing specialist populate the Redwood_invoice_template.xlsx and upload a PDF copy to the portal today (PO 4342). If the portal matching fails we’ll email ap@redwood.ai with the PDF and the XLSX mapping file.

One quick ask: can you confirm the preferred email subject line when emailing invoices so our automatic email system tags them correctly (e.g., “Invoice: Redwood PO 4342 — Archway”)?

I’ll follow up with the upload link once done. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Jordan
Jordan Baxter
Vendor Ops Manager, Archway AI
notes: Thread captures procurement + finance alignment on vendor onboarding. Internal participants limited to real Redwood employees per agents.md. Messages include realistic quoting and attachment stubs.
